risks.risk: The VPS checkout is not a clean git copy
risks.detail: ~/mahara-cockpits sits on 7545850 (2026-09-19) with 84 porcelain entries. hermes/sales-desk (live calls M1 + proposal generator) and hermes/cockpit-guardian are untracked at HEAD, as are eod-out, review-import, webinar-pull and ~50 supabase/migrations files; editor-desk, ideation-radar and team-sync have uncommitted edits. A git clean -fd, git reset --hard, re-clone or fresh checkout would delete every running cockpit worker. A plain git pull would refuse on the untracked files rather than overwrite them.
risks.mitigation: Today the code matches origin/main e166a0b, so it can be re-copied from git or from the restore tag; a tar of the two folders into ~/backups/2026-10-07-pre-migration/ plus the bucket is the belt and braces.
